description: "Ginx's Baby: His Birth and Other Misfortunes; a Satire" by Edward Jenkins is a satirical novel likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story begins with the birth of Ginx's Baby to Mrs. Ginx in a poor and overcrowded household, highlighting the struggles of working-class life in Victorian England.

authorInfo.bio: Edward Jenkins (1838–1910) is the author of Ginx's Baby: His Birth and Other Misfortunes; a Satire. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
